verdict.rationale: A SaaS feature-flag platform could reasonably publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The probes found nothing: https://launchdarkly.com/llms.txt and /docs.md both returned 404, and no evidence item documents a machine-readable or agent-oriented docs surface. The official MCP server and CLI are separate capabilities and earn no credit here; the probes also did not check paths under /docs, so absence there is unconfirmed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
